Container.Name: beszel-agent
Container.Overview: Beszel monitoring agent — reports system stats back to the hub. Uses host networking so the hub can reach it via SSH.[br][br]Requires the SSH public key from your hub's Settings → Keys page.

Config.Name: KEY
Config.Description: SSH public key from the hub (Settings → Keys). Required for the agent to authenticate with the hub.

Config.Name: SENSORS_EXCLUDE
Config.Description: Comma-separated sensor names to exclude. The default suppresses phantom sensors common on Supermicro/ASUS server boards (unwired AUXTIN, PCH, voltage and intrusion pins). Run 'sensors -u' on the host to see your actual sensor names and adjust this list.

Config.Name: Docker Socket
Config.Description: Docker socket for container stats reporting. Read-only.
